title: Important: grafana-pcp security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description:
The Grafana plugin for Performance Co-Pilot includes datasources for scalable time series from pmseries and Redis, live PCP metrics and bpftrace scripts from pmdabpftrace, as well as several dashboards.

Security Fix(es):

* crypto/x509: golang: Go crypto/x509: Certificate validation bypass due to incorrect DNS constraint application (CVE-2026-33810)

* crypto/x509: crypto/tls: golang: Go: Denial of Service vulnerability in certificate chain building (CVE-2026-32280)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Update to new grafana-pcp release (JIRA:Rocky Linux-169811)

* [grafana-pcp / rhel-10.3] Remove Lua ExclusiveArch macro for Konflux build (JIRA:Rocky Linux-188288)

* Rebase to grafana-pcp v6.1.0 (JIRA:Rocky Linux-243641)

* grafana-pcp: return a clear error when geomap queries lack latitude/longitude labels (JIRA:Rocky Linux-182453)

* [RFE] Add grafana-pcp dashboards for Rocky Linux AI (JIRA:Rocky Linux-58940)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

Additional Changes:

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Rocky Linux 10 Release Notes linked from the References section.
